name: scope-context
description: A scope-bound bundle of storage, cache, request, comms, and theme adapters — created once per scope (tenant/org/session), so cross-scope leakage is structurally impossible rather than a naming convention. Every axis is optional and pluggable; zero-dep defaults (in-memory cache/storage, fetch, BroadcastChannel, CSS custom properties) work out of the box.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node ../../scripts/write-dual-pkg.mjs dist
